review_method: Original OGS map pixels, complete source and baseline-rendered ring plots, independently registered outlines, wider context, imprint and credits. All 165 ordered positions across three single-ring Polygons were compared with original source geometry, decoded geometry and exact original inventory/core/detail joins. The original primary viewport geographic controls and coordinate system were reopened, a full six-parameter affine was independently derived from all four controls, cross terms retained, and MediaBox/CropBox offsets explicitly applied. All 165 registrations agree with the comparison overlays; all three original crop pixel arrays match fresh PDF renders. The largest control residual is under 0.001 PDF point; this is registration consistency, not shoreline accuracy. Initial pixel observations were refined using original water/land fill and wider context before final reconciliation. Original hydrographic coverage is available throughout all three selected footprints. The production decoder was not independently replayed by this reviewer.
counted_unit: Distinct logical inventory lake target IDs; repeated map labels do not increase the target count.
